lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-damage budget appropriation — real money to cover real destruction to TIS and TMHS — and that's the most concrete decision hitting any public body this week. Alongside it, the Ethics Commission takes up a Code of Conduct recommendation for Town officials, Mountain Village's HOA moves to form a Workforce Housing Committee, and the county digs into childcare funding implications. A full week of government with actual stakes, not just updates.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-related budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission recommends whether Town officials get a formal, enforceable Code of Conduct.
County weighs CCAP childcare funding and its real budget consequences for residents.
Hospital board may act on Two Site Model, shaping what new facility gets built and where.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and act on updated board policies.
